description: This PHP script manages the account preferences for the 'tracker' section in the Revive Adserver admin interface. It handles loading preferences, processing form submissions to update preferences, and rendering the preferences form with options for tracker status, type, and link campaigns.

classes.description: Class for managing admin options and preferences display.
